hook.line: I'm not supposed to be showing you this, but here's how to use AI in Search Console.
hook.visual: Tight handheld selfie of a bearded man in an office, hand reaching at the lens, glancing over his shoulder as if checking no one sees; blue title 'Search Console Tip' on top.

beats.what: Secret-sharing opener with a conspiratorial glance over his shoulder
Cut to a phone filming his monitor: Google Search Console, Performance tab
Custom (regex) filter box with the long-query expression typed in
Result: a list of long, question-style queries likely coming from AI
Cut back to his face: turn those queries into new or updated content
Payoff list: better ranking, more AI overview mentions, more traffic and leads

why_it_works: 'Not supposed to show you this' plus a glance over his shoulder frames a free tip as forbidden insider knowledge
Shows the exact clicks and the regex on screen, so the video is worth saving (323 shares in the meta)
Face, then screen, then face structure: the middle 23 s are pure proof, bracketed by promise and payoff
weaknesses: The monitor is filmed with a phone at an angle, so the regex and query list are hard to read
No spoken captions, only a static title; the audio is very quiet (-42.5 LUFS)
The secrecy claim is never paid off; nothing in the tip is actually hidden
for_robert: Borrow the conspiratorial glance-over-the-shoulder hook: Fred can peek in from the edge of frame and shush the camera before Robert shares a 'secret' tip, then swim off when the demo starts.
